Welcome to The PT Mama! No medical advice!
I’m Ashley: a pediatric physical therapist, mom of two, and your go-to for real talk on baby and toddler development.

On this channel, I break down everything from motor milestones to baby products, and parenting myths.. without the fluff or fear-mongering. Whether you’re trying to figure out if your baby should be standing yet, questioning that viral TikTok “hack,” or navigating baby toy decisions, I’ve got you.

I’m here to help you feel informed, confident, and supported.. while keeping it honest, educational, and sometimes a little savage (in the best way).

🍼 Subscribe and let’s raise kids who move with confidence.. from day one.
